subject: [PATCH v3] btrfs: trigger cow fixup via dirty_folio()

reviews.author: Qu Wenruo
reviews.summary: Reviewer Qu Wenruo pointed out that their previous Reviewed-by tag was intended for an older version of the patch, not this one.
reviews.raw_body:
Reviewed-by: Qu Wenruo <wqu@suse.com>

Please ignore my previous reviewed-by tag on the older version.
I was doing a diff checking the changes, and replied to the wrong patch.

Thanks,
Qu

2026-07-28.patch_summary: This patch reintroduces a fixup mechanism to handle a specific scenario where a dio read operation sees a dirty destination page, but by the time it finishes reading, the page is clean due to btrfs writing it back. The fixup ensures that the dio read re-dirties the folio to prevent data corruption. This patch addresses an issue that was previously thought to be resolved with advances in preventing such re-dirtying, and reintroduces a mechanism that was first introduced in 2008.
